notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separate upper-cabinet doors and two separate drawers. The two cabinet-door closing times are close together and partially obscured, so their individual attribution is less certain than the drawer transitions.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, opens the wide food drawer left of the stove and the utensil drawer right of the stove, then closes the cabinet doors and later closes both drawers.
